purpose: One final test of the already selected S02 model; no fitting, selection, tuning or filtering by error
split: Original host_split: SHA256(staylens-v1:host_id), first 8 hex digits modulo 100; test >=85
eligibility: Original S02: host present, finite price >0, 52.3<latitude<52.7 and 13.05<longitude<13.8; no upper price cutoff
features: Original frozen source_features and feature_frame; same 18 fields as S02

bootstrap.interval: paired MAE improvement, percentile 95%, not individual prediction interval

additional_diagnostic: Count test feature rows identical to train/validation without removing them from scores
decision: Keep deployed S02 irrespective of test results; report shortcomings honestly
storage: Predictions with identifiers only under ignored artifacts/s05-final; publish aggregates, hashes and code
repeat_policy: Refuse to overwrite an existing evaluation; independent recomputation from saved predictions is verification, not new model selection
